facts.text: Eve? Sit. Snack cake for you, movie on the screen. Please stay.
facts.why: Not a line in the film. Wall-E barely speaks (Ta-da, Directive, Eve). The panel is headed 'From the flight deck', and the Captain's real line about wanting to live fits the Axiom setting.
facts.fix: I don't want to survive! I want to live!
